description: This file defines the InventoryStockRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository for InventoryStock entities, providing methods to query inventory stock data, including a method for pessimistic locking.

classes.name: InventoryStockRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for InventoryStock entity with custom query methods including locking for concurrent updates.

methods.name: findByStoreIdAndSku
methods.description: Retrieves an InventoryStock by store ID and SKU.

methods.name: findByStoreIdAndSkuForUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves an InventoryStock by store ID and SKU with a pessimistic write lock.
